title: Assistant Town Planner
description:
Job Title: Assistant Town Planner

Ref: BM332

Location: Maidstone

Salary: £29,000 - £35,000

This is a fantastic opportunity to join one of the UKs leading independent planning consultancy who provide a wide range of expertise to the residential, industrial, commercial, education, and healthcare sectors. They are on the lookout for an enthusiastic and talented Assistant Town Planner to join their growing team in Maidstone.

Benefits for the role of Assistant Town Planner include:
- Highly competitive salary
- Contributory pension scheme
- Hybrid working
- Generous holiday allowance
- Professional development
- Personal development

Duties for the role of Assistant Town Planner:
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications
- Undertaking research into planning policy, legislation and guidance
- Reviewing local and national planning policies and identifying their implications for development proposals
- Assisting with planning appraisals and development feasibility assessments
- Supporting the preparation of planning statements, reports and other technical documents
- Liaising with local planning authorities, consultants, clients and other stakeholders
- Monitoring planning applications and assisting with the management of project programmes
- Attending meetings, site visits and planning committees where appropriate

Requirements for the role of Assistant Town Planner:
- RTPI Accredited degree within town planning or another related discipline
- Relevant experience within a planning consultancy, local authority or related planning environment, although strong graduates will also be considered
- An understanding of the UK planning system and relevant planning policy
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent research, analytical and organisational abilities
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines
- Good attention to detail
- Confidence communicating with colleagues, clients and external stakeholders
- A proactive approach and willingness to learn
- A genuine interest in the built environment, development and planning

If this role interests you or if you are interested in searching for other roles relating to Town Planning please feel free to contact Ben Moore on or email . There are many more roles available on our website at . This is a permanent role

title: Logistics Coordinator - Operations & Quality
company: Pearson Whiffin Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Logistics Coordinator - Quality and Operations

£30,000 - £31,000

Monday to Friday, office-based position

Mid Kent

We are currently supporting a well-established manufacturing business in the Maidstone area with the recruitment of a Logistics & Quality Coordinator.

This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys a combination of coordination, administration and hands-on operational work. You'll work closely with teams across the business, including production, warehouse and logistics, helping to ensure orders are prepared and dispatched accurately and on time.

The role would suit someone with experience in dispatch, logistics, warehouse administration or manufacturing, who is comfortable working across both office and operational environments.

Duties:
- Coordinating deliveries and collections with transport providers
- Preparing shipping and delivery documentation and keeping records up to date
- Using an ERP system to process orders, stock movements and dispatch information
- Carrying out basic quality and quantity checks before goods are dispatched
- Monitoring stock levels and supporting inventory checks
- Liaising with customers and internal teams regarding deliveries and order requirements
- Supporting the warehouse and production teams with picking, packing and preparing goods for dispatch
- Investigating and escalating any delivery, quality or operational issues
- Producing basic reports and maintaining accurate administration
- Working in line with company health and safety procedures

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, practical and enjoys working in a busy environment. You don't need to have experience in every part of the role, but you'll ideally bring some experience from a logistics, dispatch, manufacturing or warehouse setting.

You'll be confident using computer systems, comfortable dealing with different people throughout the day and have a good eye for detail. Experience with SAP or another stock/ERP system would be useful.

The role also has a hands-on element, so you'll need to be happy getting involved on the operational side rather than being purely office-based. Experience with deliveries, transport companies, stock or quality checks would be a bonus.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone reliable, proactive and willing to get stuck in.

This role is being handled by Holly Ensoll and Chloe Wadhams Recruitment Consultant for Pearson Whiffin Recruitment.

Not quite the right role but still looking?

Whether you are entry or Executive level, our team of experienced Recruitment specialists can help you with your career. We are Kent's leading independent consultancy and pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional service to both candidates and clients.

Find us on and

By working with us, you will be helping support charities across Kent; we have raised over £50,000 so far!

title: Logistics Planner
description:
Job Title: Logistics Planner

Location: Barling Farm, Maidstone ME17 3 DX

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full time, Permanent

Working Hours: 47.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday

About Us:

Four Jays, part of the Heathcote Holdings group, is an integrated business supplying the needs of all types of welfare hire across the South East. The company prides itself on providing solutions to our clients promptly and professionally, whilst continuing to expand within a rapidly moving sector

About the Role:

Four Jays are looking for a Logistics Planner to oversee and coordinate the efficient movement of goods and services within the organisation.

Responsibilities:
- To assist the Hire Logistics Manager in the day to day planning of the deliveries, collections, and servicing of the hire fleet
- To review, allocate and schedule jobs using the company's MCS hire system.
- To learn and manage the MCS platform to drive fleet efficiency
- Interact with the hire desk, fleet drivers and operations teams to ensure the smooth day to day scheduling of the work programme
- Liaise with drivers on a regular basis throughout the day to ensure
- Ensure that all queries within the logistics department are dealt with in a timely and professional manner
- Adopt a can-do attitude toward the day to day tasks
- Be prepared to assist other parts of the business with new lines of work and opportunities
- Adopt a positive attitude towards learning and complying with the company's management systems
- Contribute towards a positive business culture through attention to detail, aspiring for excellence, and team work

About you:

Essential Requirements:
- Knowledge and experience of event and/or hire planning and scheduling
- Transport familiarity or experience
- Good knowledge and use of maps
- Good knowledge of the south east of England road network
- Good numeracy
- IT Literate. Experience of Microsoft Office including in order of importance:
- Outlook
- Teams
- Word
- Excel
- Punctual
- Full driving license

Benefits:
- Life Insurance with access to GP24
- Commitment to wellbeing through Employee Assistance Programme
- Electric Car salary sacrifice scheme for eligible employees
- Cycle to work scheme
- Company Events
- GymFlex salary sacrifice

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV for this role.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job title of; Logistics Planner, Transport Operations Executive, Goods In Coordinator, Distribution Co-Ordinator, Operations Administrator, Logistics Operations Executive, Import Co-Ordinator, Export Coordinator, Logistics Administrator, Logistics Coordinator, Shipment Coordinator, Export, Transport Coordinator, Logistics Supervisor Stock Control Coordinator, Supply Chain Coordinator, Operations Administrator may also be considered for this role.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
The Supply Chain Coordinator role offers an exciting opportunity to support procurement and supply chain operations within the industrial and manufacturing industry. Based in Maidstone, this position requires a detail-oriented individual to ensure the smooth flow of goods and services across the supply chain.

Client Details

The employer is a well-established organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector, known for its commitment to delivering high-quality products and services. As a global business, they offer a structured work environment with a focus on operational efficiency and excellence.

Description
- Coordinate procurement activities to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
- Monitor inventory levels and liaise with suppliers to manage stock replenishment.
- Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, invoices, and supplier agreements.
- Analyse supply chain data to identify areas for improvement and cost savings.
- Support the implementation of supply chain processes and systems to enhance efficiency.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment on procurement needs and timelines.
- Resolve any supplier issues to maintain strong working relationships.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and industry regulations.

Profile

A successful Supply Chain Coordinator should have:
- Previous experience in procurement or supply chain operations within the industrial or manufacturing industry.
- A strong understanding of inventory management and procurement processes.
- Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency in using supply chain management software or ERP systems.
- An eye for detail and the ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines.
- A commitment to maintaining high standards of accuracy and compliance.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary
- Supportive and professional work environment
- Opportunities to develop expertise in procurement and supply chain management.
- Benefits package to be confirmed.

If you're looking to grow your career as a Supply Chain Coordinator within the industrial and manufacturing industry, apply now to join this reputable organisation in Maidstone.

title: Administrative Assistant
company: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
description: Are you a dedicated, compassionate Admin Assistant? Do you want the chance to help shape a new and genuinely innovative service for care in Kent and Medway? You will be providing direct admin support to members of the clinical team. We are an adaptive, cross-functional service. Whilst being assigned to directly support a department, you will be providing support (as a team) throughout the Directorate. Teamwork is an essential part of this role, good time-keeping and the ability to keep to deadlines and adapt your way of working are vital. As a support service, we adapt to the needs of the service; we are regularly reviewing ways of working and optimising our internal processes. We need someone who can think on their feet and adapt to day-to-day circumstances as they arise. If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for, come and join our diverse and compassionate team committed to delivering excellent care and support for service users and their loved ones. ** Please note, Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.** This role provides direct administrative support to our in-patient care, Management, Consultant Psychiatrist, Lead clinicians and the wider team. The successful candidate will work closely with the teams: Providing up-to-date information to the teams and producing simple report Maintaining patient records Providing Reception support Creation and maintenance of spreadsheets and internal forms within designated timescales Maintaining and updating displays Scheduling clinical meetings Diary and meeting management Generic team mailbox monitoring and maintenance and any other administrative duties requested Please see the attached job description for full details of the main duties and responsibilities of the role.

title: Administrator
company: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Kent and Medway Mental Health NHS Trust
description: This office-based role provides a high level of administration support to the Maidstone and Pembury Liaison Psychiatry Service in its 24-hour provision of mental health assessments for individuals who attend the Emergency Department or are admitted on medical/surgical wards and have mental health needs. The post may provide back-up support to the other West Kent hospital site, which may require very occasional travel to Tunbridge Wells Hospital - most of this support can be provided remotely from Maidstone Hospital. Provide comprehensive admin support to the team/service. Support the team manager with staffing levels, covering shifts and booking NHSP bank/agency staff. Answer telephone calls and take messages or divert to the relevant person. Provide support with caseload management using Rio, including monitoring to ensure all mandatory documentation has been completed. Monitor various data sources to ensure accuracy. Monitor Business Intelligence reports for performance compliance and highlight and rectify any errors. Ensure resources (such as forms, leaflets, documents) and supplies for the team are replenished and ordered in a timely manner. Keep accurate and up-to-date service data records. Send invites and produce meeting agendas, minutes other meeting papers. Maintain and update information resources in the office. Please refer to the attached job description for the full details on the responsibilities and person specification.
